timing: batched: one features call covers 96 episodes; one head fit is 300 LBFGS iterations
aggregation: cap basis = mean over repeats; median and max disclosed alongside
cap_basis_note: a single contention outlier can make the max basis non-predictive (the first pricing pass measured head cpu_max at 32x cpu_median), so the cap is set from the mean basis, which already carries the outlier's contribution; the live ratio is disclosed in head_outlier_ratio_max_over_median and the max basis is not adopted
low_tick_limit: single-call timing below the ~0.0156 s process_time resolution is a tick lottery, not a measurement; every timed unit here is a batch

discipline.head_optimizer: LBFGS on diagnostic heads only, never on the graph
